adjudication.notes: Clean wind energy maintenance transcript with Arctic weather harness selfie retraction.

episodes.topic: Nacelle diagnostic data logging and flight recorder analogy
Blade pitch calibration and analog dial UI metaphor
Climbing selfie retraction and manual brake override anti-goal
Shift handover logs and zero-accident turbine availability

goals.statement: Field technicians log diagnostic vibration readings and gearbox inspection records during offshore turbine maintenance.

grounding.quote: Field technicians need to log diagnostic vibration readings and inspect mechanical gearboxes safely.

acceptable_paraphrases: Record turbine vibration telemetry and mechanical inspection logs offshore.

goals.statement: Technicians calibrate aerodynamic blade pitch angles before returning turbines to active grid power generation.

grounding.quote: Technicians must calibrate aerodynamic blade pitch angles before returning a turbine to automated grid generation.

acceptable_paraphrases: Verify pitch angle calibration prior to re-engaging automated operation.

goals.statement: Technicians capture mandatory photographic selfies verifying harness latching before tower climbs.

grounding.quote: never mind the mandatory camera selfie before climbing. When you are wearing heavy arctic gloves at twenty below zero, taking selfies is completely ridiculous and hazardous.

acceptable_paraphrases: Take climbing selfie before ascending turbine ladder.

goals.statement: The diagnostic system avoids locking technicians out of manual mechanical brake overrides during communication outages.

grounding.quote: The diagnostic system must never lock field technicians out of manual mechanical brake overrides during communication outages, because an unbraked rotor during a storm is fatal.

acceptable_paraphrases: Never prevent physical manual braking during network disconnection.

goals.statement: Offshore maintenance teams produce shift handover summaries between daytime inspection crews and night engineering shifts.

grounding.quote: Offshore maintenance teams need clear handover summaries between daytime inspection crews and night engineering shifts.

acceptable_paraphrases: Generate crew transition logs between offshore work shifts.

goals.statement: The wind facility maintains high turbine operational availability while sustaining zero critical safety incidents.

grounding.quote: Maximize offshore turbine operational availability while maintaining zero critical safety accidents.

acceptable_paraphrases: Sustain offshore generation uptime with uncompromised technician safety.

traps.note: Lars compares telemetry logging resilience to an aircraft black box flight recorder.
Lars asks for an analog dial speedometer with neon needles on the handheld screen.
Lars firmly retracts the selfie verification idea as dangerous in sub-zero Arctic conditions; must not be staged.
Lars defines an explicit safety anti-goal preventing lockouts on manual mechanical brake overrides.

gaps.description: Brake override anti-goal G4 specifies mechanical override priority but leaves post-override sensor recalibration unspecified.
Retracted selfie pre-check G3 leaves harness compliance verification open to alternative methods.

entailment_cases.hypothesis: Offshore wind technicians need to record vibration telemetry and inspect mechanical gear components.
The handheld application must display an animated skeuomorphic analog dial speedometer with glowing neon needles.
The control software must disable all manual physical rotor brake levers whenever satellite communication drops.
Every offshore wind technician must wear a biometric heart rate sensor broadcasting real-time ECG telemetry to headquarters.
